title: Mur Pano language - Wikipedia
text: Mur Pano, or simply Pano, is an Austronesian language spoken by about three quarters of the thousand inhabitants of Mur village on the north coast of Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. The other quarter of the population speaks Molet as their primary language.
